name: Tabs
summary: Grouped navigation for switching between peer views without leaving the current context.
description: Grouped navigation for switching between peer views without leaving the current context. Orientation controls horizontal or vertical layout; Density supports default and compact applications.

orientation.horizontal: Lays out along the inline axis.
orientation.vertical: Lays out along the block axis.

states.Orientation=Horizontal, Density=Default: fill muted · radius radius/lg · text foreground · type size/12

dos: Reference variables for every value; never hardcode a hex or px.
Change state through props, never by detaching the instance.
Keep one tab selected at all times.
Keep labels short enough to fit on one line without wrapping.
Preserve each panel's state when switching away and back.
whenToUse: Switch between peer views of the same subject, within one context.
whenNotToUse: Steps in a sequence — use a stepper.
Content the reader needs to compare side by side, or to find with the browser's search.
Navigating to a different page — use links.
donts: Do not scroll or wrap tabs into a second row — reconsider the grouping.
Do not hide required form fields in an unselected tab.

keyboard: Arrow keys move between tabs; Home and End jump to the first and last.
Tab moves from the tab list into the active panel.
notes: Each tab carries aria-selected and aria-controls; each panel is labelled by its tab.
Only the selected tab is in the tab order.
